entities.summary: Justino Monteiro dos Santos Victoriano best known as Puna Victoriano, is a former Angolan basketball player. Puna, a 6'7" / 220lb Center born in Luanda, he played for Angola at the 1996 Summer Olympics and 1999 Afrobasket. On the club level, he played for Petro Atlético.
